applicabilityBasis.summary: IDRX is a 1:1 IDR-backed, redeemable stablecoin explicitly marketed for global payments and transfers.

genius.notes: Evidence reviewed 2026-10-07: IDRX is a 1:1 IDR-denominated payment/transfer stablecoin issued by PT IDRX Indo Inovasi in Indonesia. Current issuer terms document minting and redemption; Indonesian domicile, reserves, local regulation and a website claim of regulated status do not establish a U.S. GENIUS approval or foreign exception. The website excludes U.S. customer access, but foreign national-currency denomination and geographic restrictions do not themselves exclude the token from the statutory functional definition. No token-specific GENIUS PPSI approval, state qualification, official application, foreign registration or issuer-announced GENIUS intent was found in the checked public sources. The August 28 reserve report is labelled agreed-upon procedures; this does not establish a monthly independent assurance attestation, and monthlyAttestationPresent remains false. Reserve disclosure now links directly to the current report, replacing the dead home.idrx.co page. Federal substantive implementation remains proposed, so not-yet-restricted records the GENIUS timeline only.

sourcesChecked: OCC Bulletin 2026-3, reopened 2026-10-07: proposed issuer and foreign-registration framework, not a token approval.

OCC Digital Assets Licensing Applications, direct HTTPS/HTML table extraction on 2026-10-07: nine pending charter applicants, none matching this token or identified issuer; this table is not an exhaustive GENIUS register.
Treasury August 17 section 3 proposal (sb0605), reopened 2026-10-07: expected January 18, 2027 effectiveness and separate DASP implementation dates.
September 30 SCRC procedural interim final rule, reopened 2026-10-07: procedures do not certify a state regime or qualify this issuer.
Federal Reserve September 24 proposals and Public Law 119-27, reopened 2026-10-07: functional payment-stablecoin definition and proposed implementation.

Public search on 2026-10-07 for IDRT, IDRX, EJPY and GMO-Z.com Trust with GENIUS, PPSI, enforcement or registration across OCC, Treasury, NYDFS, FDIC, NCUA, Federal Reserve, SEC, CFTC and FinCEN domains. No exact token-specific GENIUS approval, application, registration or enforcement result located; unrelated biotechnology IDRx results excluded.
https://idrx.co/en/ - Current 1:1 peg, global-payment use and country restrictions; no GENIUS announcement.
https://app.idrx.co/assets/docs/idrx-terms-n-condition-en.pdf - Issuer legal identity, platform redemption obligations and conditional international eligibility.
https://docs.idrx.co/services/redeem-idr - On-chain burn and bank-payout process.
https://idrx-prod-public-docs.s3.ap-southeast-3.amazonaws.com/Reserve%20Transparency%20Report%20IDRX%20August%202026.pdf - Official issuer-linked current reserve AUP; no U.S. authorization claim.
https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/sb0435 - April 8 AML/CFT proposal; previous state-comparability label was incorrect.
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, the opened issuer terms, current website and reserve disclosures, OCC pending application table and regulator rulemaking sources did not establish a token-specific U.S. GENIUS approval, state qualification, official application, registered foreign exception or announced GENIUS route for IDRX or PT IDRX Indo Inovasi. The current foreign issuance/payment-redemption evidence supports apparent-payment-stablecoin; absence findings are limited to the public sources checked.
